# First Critique — Twenty Corrections

The Awtsmoos burns away ambiguity; Awtsmoos.com lets each contract stand plain;
these twenty gates prevent hidden prompt logic from returning through another name again.

1. Literal text layers must remain legal; only semantic inference from text is forbidden.
2. JSON parsing is syntax processing, not natural-language interpretation.
3. Validation errors should use codes and paths usable by agents.
4. Mechanical defaults may fill omitted numeric/structural fields but must not invent story semantics.
5. Unknown extension metadata should survive round trips when safe.
6. Schema version must be explicit.
7. Public exports must stop advertising prompt/provider APIs.
8. Runtime option objects must stop accepting provider callbacks.
9. App installers must stop reading `AwtsmoosMovieAiProvider` globals.
10. Revision must accept explicit patch data only.
11. UI should say Data/Import, not Prompt/Generate.
12. External agents need a programmatic load entrypoint, not just a textarea.
13. External agents need capability discovery.
14. Tests must grep/runtime-check that prompt interpretation modules are unreachable.
15. Existing showcase data must continue to validate/render.
16. Existing adapters must receive canonical movie objects unchanged semantically.
17. Mobile UI must retain import/edit/preview usability.
18. Data import must reject malformed JSON without mutating current movie.
19. Data import must reject schema-invalid objects with actionable paths.
20. Text strings such as `orbit` inside captions must never alter camera behavior.
